create_vlm_training_params: create a VLMTrainingParams instance with default settings for vision-language model training
configure_vlm_model: configure VLMTrainingParams to use a custom model name like google/paligemma-3b-pt-224
set_vlm_data_params: set the data_path, train_split, and valid_split fields on VLMTrainingParams for your dataset
configure_vlm_peft_lora: configure VLMTrainingParams with peft enabled and custom lora_r, lora_alpha, and lora_dropout values
set_vlm_trainer_type: set the trainer field on VLMTrainingParams to captioning, vqa, segmentation, or detection
